text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We're halfway through summer camp, and Bamboo Memory has been pushing herself to the limits in her training.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Finished! Huff, puff… Huff, puff… Whew!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That's not everything, is it? I can keep going!
choice_data_list: We should rest for now and prep for tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm totally fine! In fact, I think I'll do some weightlifting at the campsite to prepare for tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Thanks for all the hard work! I'll see you tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm pretty sure the striking performance her rivals put on at the Japanese Derby is what's got Bamboo Memory so fired up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm glad she's so enthusiastic, but I'm also worried she might injure herself with all this training.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Yeaaah, I'd say you've done enough. How 'bout ya leave the rest to us?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's Inari One, an older student with an old-school Edo vibe. She's got renowned senior-year racer Tamamo Cross in tow.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: We can't just sit back and watch ya run yourself ragged like this.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: That's right! We're happy to pitch in if ya need us.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Festival training?! This is the first I've heard of that! What is it?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: You really don't know? It's a Tracen Academy summer camp tradition.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Usually, people who've tried it before invite the newbies, but I guess we're the first to say anything.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: But it's not too late to start! Festival trainin's like a real shock to the system—even the air feels electric!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: It does?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Don't forget how much fun ya have doin' it! And since there's no extra strain, you can do it as much as you want!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ohhh! So that means my trainer won't have to worry either!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I wanna try festival training!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Let's do it! What should we focus on first, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've never heard of this kind of training, but Inari One and Tamamo Cross seem to have thought it through, so I'll follow their lead…
choice_data_list: How about we work on strength?
How about we work on strength?
Let's do something that'll fuel your gutsy spirit!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Okay, festival strength training it is! Let's go, let's go, LET'S GOOO!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oh, I like that attitude! Then we're off to the trainin' grounds!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh! So this is it! …Uh, what do I do exactly?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: All righty! Ya see those pineapples over there? You're gonna go collect all of them! We call it harvest festival trainin'!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I have to harvest pineapples?! That's a bit odd for training, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yeah, but they're super heavy! They're not goin' anywhere unless ya put your back into it!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Then ya gotta squeeze the juice from the pineapples for some special shaved ice! You can't have a festival without shaved ice!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: This really is like a harvest festival! All right, I'm on it!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah! Piiineaaaaapple!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Grrrrr! Dang! This is tougher than I thought!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hehe, there's a trick to it! You can't just use brute force. Try twistin' your body while you pull.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hm… Like this?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh! It's starting to come out! You're amazing, Inari!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Keep it up! Give it all you got! Twist! Shout! Squeeze it all out!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Pfft, hehe… Hey! Stop it! Don't make me laugh!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Not so much force! Just keep pullin'!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: G-got it! Here I go! Reeeady, aaaaand…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Maaan, this is some good juice! I don't think I can ever go back to eating regular shaved ice!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Really hits the spot after some hard work, right?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: This is the best part of the harvest festival! How you feelin', Bamboo?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: It doesn't get much better than working out and eating amazing shaved ice!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Yeah, this is the life! Let's keep the good times rollin'!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Thank you all so much!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory seems a lot more relaxed after her festival training.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Like what?! Tell me! Tell me!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I got the perfect workout then! You're gonna love it!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: It's quite simple. Just use this to take down Mr. Bear!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: …A toy gun? Oh, it's a shooting range!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: You've got it! Each year, tons of fearless challengers come to try and take home the giant stuffed bear! Now it's your turn!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Sounds like quite the formidable foe! Ohhh, I'm all fired up!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: First, let me show you how it's done! Aim for the sweet spot and… take it down clean!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bang!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ah, you're aimin' for the pedestal! It sure is rockin'—didja get it?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ah! Too bad! But you've still got another ch—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Nope! One shot and you're done. But an Edo girl always accepts defeat graciously.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: You're so cool, Inari!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hold up, ya can't just waste your extra shots!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'm here to get some prizes for the kiddos! I'm not about to let pride get in the way!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Now eat this, ya big bear! And this! And this! And this!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Dang! Talk about a quick shot! You've got this!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Aw, I missed every shot! The recoil messed up my aim!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: So the rumors are true. That bear is every bit as tough as they say. But you're gonna show us some real fireworks next, aren't ya, Bamboo?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: That's right! You can do it, Bamboo! Don't let our efforts go to waste!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ngh… Okay, you two! I won't let you down! I've got this!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I just gotta do two things! Aim for the pedestal like Inari showed me, and hit a bunch of shots at once like Tamamo!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: It's wobbling like crazy! Go! Go!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Gooooo!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Man, I feel kinda bad! You're the one who won the bear, after all.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Give it to your little siblings! Just winning it was good enough for me!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: …It's just too bad that we'll never face this bear again.
choice_data_list: We've just got to find you another!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That's… that's a great idea! If we can find something as fun as this, I'm all for it!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Let's all do this again sometime! Festival training is the best!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory has a great time training up her unshakable spirit with the older students.
